summary: Independent review found no blocking or important issues. 17 rows map one-to-one to the 17 deposited RAW files and to design individuals A-Q; per-bull fertility values match the deposited design exactly; all controlled terms resolve. Three minor provenance/completeness notes.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent without producer transcript; producer report/manifest treated as untrusted claims and re-checked against scratchpad/PXD021245 only

spec_compliance.evidence: 17 data rows x 29 columns, uniform field count; templates ms-proteomics + vertebrates (v1.1.0) declared and appropriate for Bos taurus MS proteomics; parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates --skip-ontology exit 0 'Everything seems to be fine'; sdrf-tools structure OK; reserved words used correctly (cell type not applicable, strain or breed not available); factor column last.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Every unique controlled value resolved in the offline OLS cache with correct family: Bos taurus NCBITaxon:9913; seminal plasma BTO:0001232; normal PATO:0000461; male PATO:0000384; adult EFO:0001272; DDA PRIDE:0000627; Q Exactive HF-X MS:1002877; Trypsin MS:1001251; DTT PRIDE:0000608; IAA PRIDE:0000599; label free sample MS:1002038; Carbamidomethyl UNIMOD:4, Oxidation UNIMOD:35 with correct TA/MT. sdrf-tools check --offline CLEAN (0 hallucinated, 0 label mismatch, 0 UNIMOD swaps).

source_evidence.evidence: Organism/organism part/instrument match PRIDE record (reconcile: all values agree). DTT/IAA/in-gel trypsin match sampleProcessingProtocol ('DDT' typo = DTT). Fixed CAM C, variable Ox M, 7 ppm / 0.02 Da, [RK]|{P} (Trypsin not Trypsin/P) match X!Tandem input parameters. factor values equal design 'fertility' column for every valbN (checked all 17). Short SDS-PAGE single gel piece supports fraction 1.

file_mapping.evidence: 17 comment[data file] values == 17 RAW entries in files_compact.json (set equality, no duplicates). valb6/valb16 mapped to _6_02/_16_02 per Proteios data header and sample_to_file.tsv; design's _01 names for these do not exist in PRIDE. Assay names equal file stems.

design_consistency.evidence: 17 bulls (A-Q) x 1 injection each = 17 rows; one source per individual; technical replicate 1, fraction 1 throughout; source name individual letter and valb number match design pairs for all rows; factor values recomputed (47.8% and 50.3% each shared by 2 bulls, as in design).

omission_safety.evidence: Breed left 'not available' (not deposited); no invented age/breed. Only unsupported-specificity candidates are the factor name 'non-return rate' (design says 'fertility') and inferred 'adult' - both reported as minor. Omitted design covariates batch/month reported as minor.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates --skip-ontology: exit 0, no errors. The --use_ols_cache_only run was OOM-killed (exit 137, host memory contention, 3 attempts); its ontology lookups were reproduced manually against the same cache parquet files (all terms found) and by sdrf-tools check --offline (CLEAN). sdrf-tools score 96/100; sdrf-tools structure OK; sdrf-tools reconcile: all values agree with deposit.

findings.message: Factor is named 'non-return rate' and values given '%' units, but the only in-scope source (second_cohort_design.tsv) calls the column 'fertility' without defining the measure; the manifest's 'same NRR measure as first cohort' cites no in-scope evidence.
findings.evidence: second_cohort_design.tsv header: FileName Project User SampleName runorder fertility individual batch month inseminations; PRIDE record does not mention NRR.
findings.correction: Cite the publication text defining fertility as (56-day) non-return rate in the manifest, or rename to factor value[fertility] with the bare deposited values.

findings.message: Design covariates batch (1/2) and sampling month (June/October), which split bulls A-J vs K-Q, are not encoded; runorder also omitted. Factor has no mirroring characteristics column (sdrf-tools score design 75).
findings.correction: Optionally add comment[batch] or characteristics[sampling time] and a characteristics[non-return rate] mirror of the factor.

findings.location: characteristics[developmental stage]; comment[proteomics data acquisition method]
findings.message: 'adult' is inferred (breeding bulls with 316-9244 inseminations), and DDA is inferred from the MGF/X!Tandem/MS-GF+ workflow; neither is stated in deposited text. The manifest's 'raw-header' source is not present in scratchpad.
findings.correction: Record these as inferences in the manifest limitations; no value change required.
